evidence: Suet. Ner. 41: nōmen gentīle resumed (Lewis & Short s.v. resūmō)
terms.comment: The Roman nōmen proper, shared by the whole gēns (Tullius); the cognōmen marked a branch of it.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 313.
